literal_meaning: তাঁতী সম্প্রদায়ও চলে গেল, বৈষ্ণব সম্প্রদায়ও চলে গেল
figurative_meaning_en: Nothing could be preserved on all sides; total loss or failure from every direction
similar_in_english: Pyrrhic victory where no one wins
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিবাদে তাঁতীকুলও গেল বৈষ্ণবকুলও গেল, কেউ লাভবান হল না।
ব্যবসায়ের ক্ষতিতে তাঁতীকুলও গেল বৈষ্ণবকুলও গেল, সবাই ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত।
example_sentences_in_english: In the dispute, the weaver's side went as well as the Vaishnava's side; no one gained.
Due to the business loss, everything went wrong on all fronts, leaving everyone at a disadvantage.
note: References traditional Bengali communities, implying mutual destruction in conflicts
